verdict.rationale: Ramp's own bill-pay docs cover invoice capture with OCR, two- and three-way line-item matching, and a payment method chosen per bill (card, ACH, check, wire). Approval workflows are documented as applying to bills, and the CLI and UI support bill approval, so the full AP loop runs inside Ramp. Missing for 10: detailed first-party documentation of bill-specific approval routing rules, and independent or hands-on corroboration of the end-to-end AP flow.

support.subject: As a finance lead, I can run accounts payable in the same platform — capture invoices, route approvals, and pay vendors by ACH, check, or wire
